an7.53:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ cārikaṃ caranti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
an7.53:1.3: tena kho pana samayena veḷukaṇṭakī nandamātā upāsikā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsati.
an7.53:2.1: tena kho pana samayena vessavaṇṇo mahārājā uttarāya disāya dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati kenacideva karaṇīyena
an7.53:2.2: assosi kho vessavaṇṇo mahārājā nandamātāya upāsikāya pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsantiyā sutvā kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno aṭṭhāsi.
an7.53:3.1: athakho nandamātā upāsikā pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsitvā tuṇhī ahosi.
an7.53:3.2: athakho vessavaṇṇo mahārājā nandamātāya upāsikāya kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā abbhānumodi
an7.53:3.6: sādhu bhadramukha tena hīyo me ayaṃ dhammapariyāyo bhaṇito idaṃ te hotu ātitheyyanti.
an7.53:3.7: sādhu bhagini etañceva me hotu ātitheyyaṃ
an7.53:3.8: sveva sāriputtamoggallānappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso veḷukaṇṭakaṃ āgamissati tañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisitvā mama dakkhiṇaṃ ādiseyyāsi
an7.53:4.1: athakho nandamātā upāsikā aññataraṃ purisaṃ accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpesi.
an7.53:4.2: athakho sāriputtamoggallānappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso yena veḷukaṇṭakaṃ tadavasari.
an7.53:4.3: athakho nandamātā upāsikā aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi
an7.53:4.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhusaṅghassa kālaṃ ārocehi
an7.53:4.5: kālo bhante ayyāya nandamātāya nivesane niṭṭhitaṃ bhattanti.
an7.53:4.6: evaṃ ayyeti kho so puriso nandamātāya upāsikāya paṭissuṇitvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhusaṅghassa kālaṃ ārocesi
an7.53:4.7: kālo bhante ayyāya nandamātāya nivesane niṭṭhitaṃ bhattanti.
an7.53:4.8: athakho sāriputtamoggallānappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena nandamātāya upāsikāya nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an7.53:4.9: athakho nandamātā upāsikā sāriputtamoggallānappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi
an7.53:5.1: athakho nandamātā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an7.53:5.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca
an7.53:5.3: ko pana te nandamāte bhikkhusaṅghassa abbhāgamanaṃ ārocesīti.
an7.53:6.1: idhāhaṃ bhante rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya pārāyanaṃ sarena bhāsitvā tuṇhī ahosiṃ
an7.53:6.2: athakho bhante vessavaṇṇo mahārājā mama kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā abbhānumodi
an7.53:6.6: sādhu bhadramukha tena hīyo me ayaṃ dhammapariyāyo bhaṇito idante hotu ātitheyyanti
an7.53:6.7: sādhu bhagini etañceva me hotu ātitheyyaṃ
an7.53:6.8: sveva sāriputtamoggallānappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho akatapātarāso veḷukaṇṭakaṃ āgamissati tañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisitvā mama dakkhiṇaṃ ādiseyyāsi
an7.53:6.10: yadidaṃ bhante dāne puññaṃ puññamahitaṃ vessavaṇṇassa mahārājassa sukhāya hotūti.
an7.53:7.2: yatra hi nāma vessavaṇṇena mahārājena evaṃmahiddhikena evaṃmahesakkhena devaputtena sammukhā sallapissasīti.
an7.53:8.1: na kho me bhante eseva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:8.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:8.3: idha me bhante nando nāma ekaputtako piyo manāpo
an7.53:8.4: taṃ rājāno kismiñcideva kāraṇe okkassa pasayha jīvitā voropesuṃ
an7.53:8.5: tasmiṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante dārake gahite vā gayhamāne vā vadhe vā vajjhamāne vā hate vā haññamāne vā nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattanti.
an7.53:9.1: na kho me bhante eseva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:9.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:9.3: idha me bhante sāmiko kālakato aññataraṃ yakkhayoniṃ upapanno
an7.53:9.4: so me teneva purimena attabhāvena uddassesi
an7.53:9.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhante abhijānāmi tato nidānaṃ cittassa aññathattanti.
an7.53:10.1: na kho me bhante eseva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:10.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:10.3: yatohaṃ bhante sāmikassa daharasseva daharā ānītā nābhijānāmi manasāpi aticarituṃ kuto pana kāyenāti.
an7.53:11.1: na kho me bhante eseva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:11.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:11.3: yadāhaṃ bhante upāsikā paṭidesitā nābhijānāmi kiñci sikkhāpadaṃ sañcicca vītikkamitāti.
an7.53:12.1: na kho me bhante eseva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:12.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:12.3: idhāhaṃ bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi
an7.53:12.4: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi
an7.53:12.5: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhikā ca viharāmi satā ca sampajānā sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi
an7.53:12.6: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmīti. da
an7.53:13.1: na kho me bhante eseva acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:13.2: atthi me aññopi acchariyo abbhuto dhammo
an7.53:13.3: yānīmāni bhante bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni nāhantesaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmīti.
an7.53:14.1: athakho āyasmā sāriputto nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
